{{Quote|What does ideology matter at this point? Is it worth being beaten to death? Look at what they did to you.|Christo, to Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
'''Christo''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Loyal to the constituents who had appointed him to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], Christo placed their needs before those of all others during his career, even the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who had been [[Cloning/Legends|bred]] to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] proposed a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|drastic increase]] in clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] production, Christo initially considered voting for the bill, especially after several opponents to the measure were pressured into supporting it by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. However, he rethought his position following an impassioned Senatorial address from Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

==Biography==
===Senator of the Republic===
{{Quote|The people I care about are my constituents, the ones who put me in office.''"<br />"''And when was the last time you ''ever'' spoke to your people?''"<br />"''Probably the same time you did. ''[To Padmé Amidala]'' Or ''you'', Senator.|Christo and Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:HalleBurtoniHS-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Senator Halle Burtoni introduced a bill to expand the Republic's clone army.]]
Christo was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] regime.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> He<ref name="Explore: Pursuit of Peace" /> was elected to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]], and he remained loyal to the people who had chosen him as their [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial representative]]. While on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to attend sessions at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Christo lived in an [[Christo's apartment/Legends|apartment]] in a residential block on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], one that provided an expansive view of the skyline of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Christo supported the Republic's [[Cloning/Legends|production]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] campaign against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the war's second [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="FF-2014 7: Katuunko">{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}</ref> Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], representing the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners who manufactured the Republic's clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|halleburtoni|Halle Burtoni}}</ref> introduced an [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|emergency appropriations bill]] to order five million additional clones for the war effort. Christo considered giving the bill his support, especially after some senators who were opposed to the measure were set upon by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who pressured them into endorsing it.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

===Unswayed===
{{Quote|But what about the millions who are dying in this war?''"<br />"''Who, the clones? We created them for just that purpose.|Farr and Christo|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:ChristosApartment-PursuitOfPeace.png|thumb|left|350px|Christo receives a visit from Senators Amidala and Farr at his apartment.]]
Christo's undecided position on the bill earned him a visit from Senators [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], two of the bill's main opponents, who desperately sought support for their side in the Senate. Christo dismissed Amidala and Farr's claims that the [[Troop/Legends|troop]] increase for the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] would mean greater [[Death/Legends|death]] tolls on the war front, believing part of the clones' purpose was to die. However, when Amidala mentioned that Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], who was also against the bill, would soon be speaking before the full Senate, Christo reconsidered his position, though only promised that he would listen to what Organa had to say.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

Before the vote on Burtoni's bill, Organa was severely injured by [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters and the scheduled address from the bill's opposition was delivered by Amidala instead,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> who garnered support in the Senate<ref name="UK Comic 6.20">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]]</ref> by arguing that the longer the war went on, the more it would consume funds for the Republic citizenry's basic services. She supplemented her case<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> with a moving account<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> of how the war had affected the life of an everyday citizen&mdash;one of her [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]]. Christo joined in the thunderous applause that followed Amidala's speech,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> which resulted in many senators joining the opposition to the bill.<ref name="UK Comic 6.20" /> Despite the efforts of Amidala's coalition, however,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> the bill was eventually passed.<ref name="Chee Twitter Spending Bill">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/10941008766308352|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-12-03|quote=For those left wondering, we learned in Season 2 Senate Murders that the military spending increase passed anyway.|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Senator Organa? Hmm. I'll listen to what he has to say.''"<br />"''So you ''are'' open to voting with us?''"<br />"''I said I'll listen to what ''he'' has to say.|Christo and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:ChristoApplauds-POP.png|thumb|right|250px|Christo applauds Senator Amidala's speech before the Senate.]]
Christo was a [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned Quarren with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. As a senator of the Republic, he was devoted to his constituents and placed their needs and views before all others during his career. He did not regard the Republic's clone troopers with much importance, believing that dying for the Republic was their purpose. When Halle Burtoni's introduced a bill to expand the clone army, he was fearful enough of being attacked for opposing the bill that he did not agree to oppose it when asked by Senators Padmé Amidala and Onaconda Farr,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> remaining uncertain how he would vote and unswayed by the senators.<ref name="Explore: Pursuit of Peace" />

Like many others in the Senate, Christo held Bail Organa in high esteem, as the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] senator was regarded as a voice of reason amidst the often indecisively argumentative Senate. After discovering that Organa was preparing to speak before the Senate on behalf of the opposition to Burtoni's bill, Christo's respect for him caused him to reconsider his endorsement of the measure, as did Amidala's address to the Senate.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

==Equipment==
When he was visited by Senators Amidala and Farr and later in the Senate, Christo wore a purple and yellow [[shirt]], gray [[Clothing/Legends|pants]], and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. He also wore a magenta [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] with dark green stripes and [[Gold/Legends|gold]] cuffs, with a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] that had a gold string and a large teardrop-shaped blue ornament. Christo's Coruscant apartment was decorated with an [[Aquarium/Legends|aquarium]], potted [[Plant/Legends|plants]], and various works of [[Artist/Legends|art]], including a sculpture.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senator Christo was developed for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and appeared in the episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," which aired on [[December 3]], [[2010]], as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. He was voiced by actor [[Jason Spisak]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" />
